title: Wear Forgiveness for Good Account Standing — Kestrel Advantage Balloon Returns
content:
**Standing benefit on returned vehicles.** On the excess wear charge for a returned Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract, the wear forgiveness of a contract in good standing is raised:

- a contract in Kestrel Advantage Balloon Tier 3, Tier 2, Tier 1 or Tier 1+ with no balloon returned payment and at least 10 balloon payments posted in the 12 calendar months ending on the billing date has its wear forgiveness raised to the wear waiver cap for its tier plus USD 250.00;
- a contract in Kestrel Advantage Balloon Tier 4 or Tier 5 with no balloon returned payment and at least 10 balloon payments posted in those months has it raised to the wear waiver cap for its tier plus USD 150.00;
- any other contract, including one with a returned payment or with fewer than 10 payments posted in those months, keeps the wear waiver cap for its tier.

Both counts are read from the contract's posting history: balloon payment entries and balloon returned-payment entries dated within the window. A window of 12 calendar months ending on the billing date takes in the dates on or before the billing date that fall fewer than 12 whole calendar months before it; whole calendar months are complete each time the later date reaches the earlier date's day of the month, so a later date that falls earlier in its month (month-end included) leaves that month incomplete.

## Combinations

| Tier group | Returned payment in the 12 months | Payments posted in the 12 months | Wear forgiveness |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tier 3, 2, 1, 1+ | None | 10 or more | Tier cap plus 250.00 |
| Tier 4, 5 | None | 10 or more | Tier cap plus 150.00 |
| Any | None | 9 or fewer | Tier cap |
| Any | One or more | Any number | Tier cap |

*Hypothetical:* a Tier 4 contract (tier cap 0.00) with 11 payments and no return in the window has wear forgiveness of USD 150.00.
